market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by widespread post-expansion consolidation and volume dry-up across all tracked assets. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and BTCUSD are consolidating in low-volume dead-zones below their respective daily Value Areas and downward-sloping VWAPs after earlier aggressive selloffs. US100 has pulled back to test its CME Globex VAH and EMA50 baseline under a negative amplifying GEX regime, but lacks the necessary volume expansion or clean breakout confirmation to justify directional execution. All six symbols default to disciplined HOLD status.

Setup lacks momentum and is caught in mean-reverting chop.
